description: USE WHEN you want buy-and-hold stressed against one named synthetic regime. Returns a 0-100 robustness score, failure-behaviour classification with confidence and the resolved regime parameters. Evaluates buy-and-hold only and takes exactly one argument, profile_hint (valid values: get_started); for other strategies use challenge_strategy or tier2_stress_test (full tier, needs an access token). Descriptive, not advisory.

profile_hint.description: Synthetic stress-regime identifier, e.g. 'whipsaw_synthetic_spy'. Valid values are listed by get_started (profile_hints) and the regimes://available resource.
